item.description: China’s latest crewed space mission, Shenzhou-24, lifted off on Wednesday morning, taking three astronauts – including the first foreign crew member – to the Tiangong space station. item.title: SCMP: Huawei guilty on 10 of 12 counts after 2-month battle in US courtroom
item.description: The nearly seven-year US criminal case against Huawei Technologies and three subsidiaries finally ended on Tuesday when a jury in Brooklyn found that the company was guilty on 10 of 12 counts, including bank and wire fraud, conspiracy to steal trade secrets and evading sanctions. The jury found the technology company not guilty of racketeering or conspiracy to obstruct justice. The exhaustive legal case, filed by the US Justice Department in January 2019, has involved dozens of lawyers…

item.title: CGTN (Chinese state media): Young Dancers on the Plateau: A Millennium-Old Promise in Every Step
item.description: Over the wild hills the wind rises, the drums echo back, and a boy takes up a thousand years of inheritance in his dancing steps. The documentary "Road of Sunshine: Young Dancers on the Plateau" follows 12-year-old Tenzin Lhapa from his rural home to the schoolyard, as he struggles to learn zhuo dance. When he finds he cannot master certain movements, he turns for guidance to Grandpa Nyima, a national-level inheritor of this intangible cultural heritage.
